Application Data.NAME: Green Air Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Air Solutions, Inc. specializes in the sale, service, and installation of residential and light commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. Our operations focus on providing routine maintenance, repair services, and new installations to ensure optimal indoor air quality and comfort. We prioritize safety and compliance with industry standards, employing certified technicians who undergo regular training on the latest HVAC technologies and environmental regulations. Our commitment to excellence has resulted in a clean safety record, and we implement strict safety protocols during all service operations. We also work closely with our clients to design customized solutions tailored to their specific needs, ensuring energy efficiency and cost-effectiveness in all installations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2022, a service technician accidentally damaged a customer's air conditioning unit while performing routine maintenance, resulting in a replacement cost of $2,500. The claim was filed immediately, and the status is currently closed with the full amount covered by the company's liability insurance.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around service areas, monitored alarm system, and on-site watchpersons during after-hours operations.
